lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in a quasi-grid pattern across the central and posterior mid-flank, with largest centroids located in the central dorsal-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a visible coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the dorsal midline, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower recesses.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a notably higher density of smaller, more concentrated high-intensity spots compared to the broader spacing of the primary lateral flank blobs.
